699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 description: I don’t waste time on introductions. If you’re working with me, you earn your place by delivering something useful. Power is one of the few things in Tarkov that still matters to everyone, even the ones pretending they’re above it. Not generators. Not lights. I’m talking about the systems behind them — communications, surveillance, private networks that never truly went dark. Somebody is keeping them alive. Somebody is profiting from them. That should be me. Bring me working components recovered from active zones. If it still functions, it has value. And if it has value, it belongs in my hands, not rusting in a ruined building.
699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 startedMessageT: Working components only. If it wasn’t recovered during an operation, it’s worthless to me.
699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 successMessageT: Good. Clean hardware, properly sourced. That tells me you understand the difference between junk and assets.
699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 completePlayerM: Everything you asked for. Recovered in raid and still functional.
6848f1776be936dd22573866 description: I’ve watched enough men die in this city to know what usually gets them killed. Not bad aim. Not bad instincts. An empty magazine at the wrong moment. Prapor stocks rifles for soldiers. Skier moves gear for opportunists. I prepare people to survive sustained violence. That means capacity. I want the kind of magazines built for long engagements, not range toys and not leftovers stripped off corpses that never saw real use. Bring me the ones that keep a gun talking longer than the other man expects.
6848f1776be936dd22573866 startedMessageT: Capacity matters. Bring me magazines that don’t run dry the second things get serious.
6848f1776be936dd22573866 successMessageT: Good. More rounds before silence. That’s how professionals stay alive.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b description: Distance makes weak men look competent. It gives them time to think, time to hide, time to convince themselves they’re in control. Factory removes all of that. No room. No comfort. No clean retreat. Just noise, steel, and decisions made faster than fear can settle in. That’s where I measure people. Not by what they promise, but by what they do when pressure closes around their throat. Go there. Fight in tight corridors where hesitation gets punished immediately. Show me you can still think when everything around you is screaming.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b startedMessageT: Factory will show me what you really are. No excuses there.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b successMessageT: You didn’t freeze. That already puts you ahead of most men I’ve met.
68498dcea603d454abc11356 description: I listen more than I speak. That’s why I’m still here. Tarkov never stopped talking — military channels, private relays, scav chatter, fragments of old infrastructure still carrying voices they were never meant to. Most people hear noise. I hear patterns. Right now, too many conversations are happening without my involvement. That means somebody else is gaining advantage from information that should be mine. I want certain areas covered. You’ll place the beacons, extend my reach, and leave without drawing attention. Once I can hear the city more clearly, I can decide which parts of it deserve to keep breathing.
68498dcea603d454abc11356 startedMessageT: Place the beacons and stay quiet. This is about control, not spectacle.
68498dcea603d454abc11356 successMessageT: Good. Silence where I need it, access where I want it. Useful.
68498dcea603d454abc11356 completePlayerM: Beacons placed. No interference on the way out.
5eca9553f3a992fe7186ffe8: Place signal beacon at first location
15981ab8ec8aa954a205a4fc: Place signal beacon at second location
603e1e94b031722bf688626d: Place signal beacon at third location
69d81cd30ffb6f16a7c38e69 description: Before this city came apart, I had agreements. Not contracts — those are for people who need paper to remember what they owe. I had understandings. Favors. Protection. Access. Men took what I offered and promised to return value when it mattered. Then Tarkov collapsed, and they convinced themselves the ledger collapsed with it. It didn’t. Debt doesn’t vanish when the system enforcing it changes. It hardens. There are still assets out there tied to my name, sitting in the hands of people who think enough time has passed. Go remind them that time does not erase obligation. It only makes collection less polite.
69d81cd30ffb6f16a7c38e69 startedMessageT: Collect what is mine. If they forgot, help them remember.
69d81cd30ffb6f16a7c38e69 successMessageT: Good. People remember quickly when the pressure is personal.
c2ed95c197979810dd2af094: Find the secured case in raid
69d81ce56cd2ce07a50d79d2 description: Goods never stop moving. Not in a city like this. They just stop moving openly. Skier watches storefront deals, trader traffic, obvious exchanges. That’s surface work. Surface work gets noticed. I’m interested in routes that exist only because the right people believe in them and the wrong people never see them. Quiet corridors. Dead drops. Movement without signatures. I’m rebuilding that network piece by piece. You’ll place what needs placing and walk away without leaving a story behind. If no one notices the route, then the route survives. That’s what I’m paying for.
69d81ce56cd2ce07a50d79d2 startedMessageT: Place the packages. Leave no trace. Quiet work lasts longer.
69d81ce56cd2ce07a50d79d2 successMessageT: Routes are active again. Quietly, exactly as intended.
69d81cf3caf46e08a1002df2 description: Money doesn’t disappear. Not really. It leaves traces — ledgers, transfers, archived backups, fragments in systems nobody bothered to wipe properly when the city fell apart. Most men don’t understand that history is just another form of leverage. I do. Some of those trails lead back to me. More importantly, some lead to people who would prefer I stay buried under old rumors and dead infrastructure. That won’t happen. Bring me the drives. I want the records intact. In the wrong hands, data becomes blackmail. In mine, it becomes architecture.
69d81cf3caf46e08a1002df2 startedMessageT: Find the drives. Bring them intact. Data is only useful when it survives.
69d81cf3caf46e08a1002df2 successMessageT: Good. Information belongs with the man who knows how to use it.
69d81cfdc17c3b97d031ff08 description: Every operation builds toward movement. Not talk. Not planning. Movement. This shipment is more than cargo. It’s influence packaged in wood and metal. The kind of thing men intercept when they want to weaken someone without saying his name aloud. Prapor’s people are watching, which means they understand just enough to be dangerous. I don’t lose shipments. Not to soldiers, not to scavengers, not to chance. You’ll keep it moving, keep it intact, and get it where it belongs. If you survive but the cargo doesn’t, then you didn’t do the job.
69d81cfdc17c3b97d031ff08 startedMessageT: Stay with the shipment. If it goes missing, so does my patience.
69d81cfdc17c3b97d031ff08 successMessageT: Delivered clean. That’s how valuable things are moved.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70e description: Everything in Tarkov touches something else. Military supply, private trade, black market routes, old signal traffic — all of it intersects whether the people involved understand it or not. Right now, one of those intersections is working against me. I don’t need a war. I need one line weakened so the rest realigns where I want it. That’s your job. Cut the right connection, restore the balance, and let everyone else wonder why their system suddenly stopped protecting them.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70e startedMessageT: Choose carefully. Quiet damage lasts longer than loud victories.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70e successMessageT: Good. That changes more than they realize.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70e completePlayerM: The target is down. The line is cut.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f description: You’ve been busy. I can tell. Things don’t move the way they should when someone starts touching wires he doesn’t understand. I built my systems to survive pressure from outside. Betrayal is different. It changes the rhythm. It leaves fingerprints in timing, in routes, in silence where there should be noise. I won’t accuse you. Not yet. Tarkov answers questions eventually. For now, I need a line cut and I need to know which side of that cut you intend to stand on. Some betrayals begin long before anyone admits what they’ve done.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f startedMessageT: Make your choice carefully. I’m paying closer attention now.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f successMessageT: Good. That confirms more than you realize.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f completePlayerM: The target is down. The line is cut.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f note: Sabotage the selected network and accept the consequences.
69d81d10f141ade1c2f23cbd description: You made your choice when you cut the right line. Most men in this city rent out their loyalty by the hour and call themselves practical. Then they die surprised when nobody bothers avenging them. I have no use for that kind of man. Up to now, you’ve been useful. That’s not the same as being trusted. I want to know if you can still stand where you claim to stand once blood is part of the price. Use what I’ve given you. Spill blood with my weapons, for my interests, and make your position unmistakable.
69d81d10f141ade1c2f23cbd startedMessageT: This is where usefulness becomes loyalty. Use my equipment and finish the work.
69d81d10f141ade1c2f23cbd successMessageT: Good. Loyalty means something only when it costs blood.
69d81d10f141ade1c2f23cbd completePlayerM: Targets are down. Your equipment held.
69d81d10f141ade1c2f23cbd note: Use Tony’s equipment to eliminate his enemies.
69d81d2211b64abb3f86ee12 description: Now that people have seen where you stand, the rest becomes simpler. Men tied to my operation have grown careless, greedy, or afraid. In my world, those are not temporary conditions. They are early stages of betrayal. They knew the rules when they took money, protection, and access from me. Now they are liabilities pretending to be associates. Remove them before hesitation spreads further than rumor already has. Quietly, efficiently, and without leaving me a second mess to clean.
69d81d2211b64abb3f86ee12 startedMessageT: Loose ends don’t stay loose for long. Handle them properly.
69d81d2211b64abb3f86ee12 successMessageT: Good. Stability is expensive. You’ve just paid part of the bill.
69d81d2211b64abb3f86ee12 note: Eliminate compromised operatives and restore control.
69d81d2e489341684c932b76 description: Control is never declared in Tarkov. It’s demonstrated. Quietly, repeatedly, until resistance becomes a bad habit with a short life expectancy. Everything before this was preparation — routes, records, shipments, loyalties, pressure points. This is where those pieces become structure. Secure the location, remove resistance, and make it clear that what remains of this city’s black market answers to me. You’ve come this far. Finish it, and you won’t just be another contractor in my books. You’ll be part of what comes next.
69d81d2e489341684c932b76 startedMessageT: No mistakes now. This is the part people remember.
69d81d2e489341684c932b76 successMessageT: It’s done. Control is established, and properly this time.
69d81d2e489341684c932b76 completePlayerM: The location is secured. Resistance is gone.
69d81d2e489341684c932b76 note: Secure Tony’s position and eliminate all remaining resistance.
69d81d3d82a2da467ea1fdba description: Men like Tony survive by believing they are always the first to know. He built his strength on awareness — who owes what, who moves where, who talks to whom when nobody is supposed to be listening. Men like that rarely consider what happens when someone inside the room decides to stop being part of it. You’ve seen enough of his operation to know where it bends and where it breaks. There are buyers for that kind of weakness, and unlike Tony, they don’t ask for loyalty. They ask for results. Plant the tracker. Walk away clean. Let the rest unfold without your name attached.
69d81d3d82a2da467ea1fdba startedMessageT: No heroics. Plant it, leave, and keep your name out of the story.
69d81d3d82a2da467ea1fdba successMessageT: Clean work. He won’t notice until it matters.
69d81d3d82a2da467ea1fdba completePlayerM: Tracker planted. No one saw me.
69d81d3d82a2da467ea1fdba note: Plant a tracking device on Tony’s operation and extract undetected.
69d81d46670bc1df8b8c3ed1 description: Every operation looks solid from the outside until someone starts naming the pieces holding it together. Tony built his network on debt, fear, routine, and the assumption that nobody close enough to hurt him would ever sell the map. That assumption was expensive. Expose enough structure and the rest won’t need to be destroyed — it’ll tear itself apart trying to survive. Locations, caches, contacts, habits. Give them what they need and let the family collapse under the weight of knowing it was never as untouchable as it pretended to be.
69d81d46670bc1df8b8c3ed1 startedMessageT: You already chose this path. Now push until it gives way.
69d81d46670bc1df8b8c3ed1 successMessageT: That will do it. The rest will collapse without much help.
69d81d46670bc1df8b8c3ed1 completePlayerM: Locations exposed. The structure is destabilizing.
69d81d50db716124768a70a0 description: Tony’s strength was never the guns, the cash, or the smugglers. It was control. The belief that nothing in Tarkov moved without passing through him first. Men followed him because they believed he could still shape outcomes in a city built on collapse. Strip away the routes, the information, the loyalists, and all that remains is a man who ran out of people willing to believe in him. Finish what was started. Leave nothing intact enough for him to build around again.
69d81d50db716124768a70a0 startedMessageT: End it completely. Half-measures are what built him in the first place.
69d81d50db716124768a70a0 successMessageT: It’s finished. He built everything on control. Now he has none.
69d81d50db716124768a70a0 completePlayerM: Operation complete. There’s nothing left for him to stand on.
